name: ad-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in Andorra for tax year 2026, read from Llei 20/2007 on SA and SL companies, Llei 10/2012 on foreign investment, the corporate tax law and the social security law, as consolidated on the Portal Jurídic d'Andorra. Covers the SL (and single-member SLU) and the SA, minimum capital of EUR 3,000 and EUR 60,000 paid in full, name reservation, the notarial deed and registration, the 15-day registry and 2-month foreign-investment decision periods, prior authorisation above 10% foreign ownership, tax and CASS registration, annual accounts, the audit thresholds, the AGM, account deposit fines, and the yearly tax filings. Use for 'set up a company in Andorra', 'Andorra SL capital', 'foreign investment authorisation Andorra'. For the tax computations see ad-corporate-income-tax, andorra-igi, ad-payroll-social and ad-tax-overview.
